explanation_short: The KNN model achieved the highest R² score (0.81717) and lowest RMSE (0.11318) compared to other models.
explanation_full: The model comparison results indicate that the KNN model performed best, achieving an R² score of 0.81717 and an RMSE of 0.11318. When comparing performance metrics, the KNN model significantly outperformed the DT model, which had the lowest R² score of 0.56045 and the highest RMSE of 0.17548. Furthermore, the RF model achieved a higher R² (0.77560) than XGBoost (0.74948) and SVM (0.73241), suggesting better overall predictive power among the tested models.
